products.name: Grain
products.note: Meeting recording AI; highlight clips; CRM integration; consent and sharing

profile_text.body:
Grain is an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence platform founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as built for growing teams, with a focus on small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. Its platform records video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings, capturing video, desktop audio, transcripts, and notes, then delivers that content to external AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for further processing.

The core product, also called Grain, generates meeting summaries, account insights, and coaching suggestions from recorded calls. It integrates with CRM systems and supports highlight clip creation and controlled sharing with clients and collaborators. Grain supports transcription and AI notes in over 130 languages, with the highest accuracy reported for English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Japanese. The company states that neither Grain nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training. A free plan covers unlimited recordings with a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day history, while paid plans start at $15 per month per user for unlimited meeting length, advanced AI features, conversational intelligence, and unlimited history.

The site's held facts show a California law exposure count of 139, suggesting notable legal or regulatory surface area in that jurisdiction, though no specific cases are currently on record for the company.
